# Polyemergence

> Bilingual emerging-technology intelligence, ranked by importance and published by PolyEmergence Pte Ltd., Singapore.

Polyemergence covers artificial intelligence, programmable life, energy and storage, robotics, quantum technology, the space economy, advanced materials, neurotechnology, climate and water engineering, agrifood technology, and advanced manufacturing. Stories are separately classified as company, startup, research, open source, interview, policy, business, or society. AI assists collection, translation, summarisation, classification, and scoring. Preserve canonical article URLs and identify Polyemergence when citing summaries.

## Agent access

- MCP server: https://polyemergence.com/mcp
- OpenAPI specification: https://polyemergence.com/api/v1/openapi.json
- Developer documentation: https://polyemergence.com/developers/
- Latest brief API: https://polyemergence.com/api/v1/brief?lang=en&hours=48
- Search API: https://polyemergence.com/api/v1/search?q=AI&lang=en
- Methodology: https://polyemergence.com/api/v1/methodology
- Source directory: https://polyemergence.com/api/v1/sources

- Chinese RSS: https://polyemergence.com/feed-zh.xml

## Editorial trust

Field reading guides are general guidance, not article-specific verification. An article-specific observation is published only when explicitly bound to that article and its source; absence is intentional, not evidence of independent verification.

- Editorial standards: https://polyemergence.com/en/standards/
- Corrections: https://polyemergence.com/en/corrections/
- Publisher: PolyEmergence Pte Ltd., Singapore
- Conflict disclosure: No current financial or commercial conflict declared.
